verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's own docs claim it is 'typically among the first providers to deploy a newly released model' and that it runs 'the latest machine learning models'. This directly addresses the story, but it is a single unquantified marketing statement with no supporting examples or independent confirmation. Missing for 10: documented release-to-availability timelines, concrete examples of day-zero open-weight launches, a new-models changelog or announcement feed, and independent or hands-on corroboration of release speed.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can get newly released open-weight models on the platform quickly after their public release

citations.quote: DeepInfra is typically among the first providers to deploy a newly released model.
DeepInfra is an AI inference cloud that makes it simple to run the latest machine learning models at scale
